literal: Actions not despised, having deliberated, one must do; things that do not fit with oneself, the world will not accept.
translation: One must deliberate and perform only those actions that are not despised by others; for the world will not accept actions that do not fit one's own character or position.
modern: பிறரால் இகழப்படாத செயல்களை ஆராய்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டும்; தன் நிலைக்குப் பொருந்தாத செயல்களை உலகம் ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளாது.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of careful deliberation before acting, focusing on social acceptance and personal alignment. The author advises that any action undertaken must be blameless and free from the scorn of the wise. Furthermore, the action must align with one's own capacity, character, and position. If a person attempts something that is incompatible with their true nature or status, society will reject it and will not support them. Thus, successful action requires both public approval and personal compatibility.
